bundles.question: For the LangGraph library (LangChain ecosystem), is there a publicly available and citable metric for the number of monthly active developers using LangGraph in September 2026?
bundles.summary:
The provided sources do **not** contain a publicly available, citable metric for **monthly active developers using LangGraph in September 2026**.

Instead, they report **non-MAU proxies**:
- Claims of **~34.5M monthly PyPI downloads** for LangGraph in **September 2026** (a download/install proxy, not monthly active developers). [https://tech-insider.org/langchain-vs-langgraph-2026] [https://uvik.net/blog/langchain-vs-langgraph]
- An official LangChain blog post about **LangGraph Cloud** (Sept 17, 2026) that does not provide a **September 2026 MAU developer count** in the retrieved excerpt. [https://www.langchain.com/blog/langgraph-cloud]

Therefore, a directly citable **“X monthly active developers using LangGraph in September 2026”** figure is not supported by the supplied evidence.
